title: US President Donald Trump arrives in Manila for ASEAN Summit
summary: US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday afternoon to attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday afternoon to attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits.
The Air Force One carrying Trump and his delegates landed at the Balagbag Ramp of the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) at 5:33 p.m.

They were welcomed by House Majority Leader and presidential son Sandro Marcos, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez, US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton, and Pasay City Mayor Imelda Calixto-Rubiano.
Trump was with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.

blocks.text: Air Force One, carrying US President Donald Trump, lands at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport, in Pasay City, Metro Manila, Philippines, November 17, 2026. REUTERS/Eloisa Lopez/Pool
The US President's visit has drawn protests from various groups across the country, mainly due to the proposed Pax Silica initiative.
US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton, however, has said that there was no scheduled announcement on the Pax Silica initiative during the ASEAN Summit.
He added that decisions would be made in “full consultation with the government of the Philippines at the appropriate time.”
Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro, meanwhile, declined to say whether an agreement on Pax Silica initiative would be signed during Trump’s visit.
Tonight is the closing ceremony of the 49th ASEAN Summit, with the Philippines set to hand over the ASEAN Chairship to Singapore.

After the ASEAN Summit, Trump, Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., and other world leaders who are in Manila are expected to fly to Shenzhen, China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders’ Summit. —VAL, GMA News
